title.en: An Act to Provide that the Municipality of Cabuntog, Surigao, Shall Be Called General Luna.

text.en:
Beginning with the approval of this Act, the municipality of Cabuntog, Surigao, shall be known
by the name of General Luna.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 25, 1929.
